name: stayscape
description: STAYSCAPE — multi-vendor hotel discovery, booking and property management platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @stayscape/shared" "npm run dev -w @stayscape/api" "npm run dev -w @stayscape/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @stayscape/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @stayscape/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stayscape/shared && npm run build -w @stayscape/api && npm run build -w @stayscape/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.services:up: docker compose up -d --wait mongo redis mailpit
scripts.services:down: docker compose stop mongo redis mailpit
